name: Nanaya
title: Mistress of Seduction
summary: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: A goddess of love and fertility, especially sensuality and physical intimacy, Nanaya is one of the most popular members of Ekur’s pantheon. She now uses her charms and favors to establish relations with deities of other realms. While Nanaya hopes this will lead to peaceful interactions, however, she has neglected to consider potential jealousies or rivalries she may leave behind.
